name: Lisboa (Humberto Delgado) Airport

curfew.v: by law no landings or take-offs between 00:00 and 06:00 UTC (23:00–05:00 UTC in summer), i.e. midnight to 06:00 local; Lisboa has a limited exception regime: a night flight must be coordinated at least one day ahead with the IATA slot coordinator and the aircraft must hold an ICAO Annex 16 Chapter 3 noise certificate
curfew.quote: On Airports and/or Aerodromes landing and/or take-off is forbidden by Law between 00:00 (23:00) and 06:00 (05:00)

slots.v: night flights under the exception regime must be coordinated at least one day in advance with the IATA airport slot coordinator
slots.quote: have had a flight coordinated with at least one day in advance with the IATA Airport Slot Coordinator, and

noise.v: night flights under the exception regime need an ICAO Annex 16, Vol I, Chapter 3 noise certificate
noise.quote: have a noise certificate according with ICAO Annex 16, Vol I, Chapt 3.

runway.v: one runway, 02/20, 3,707 m long and 45 m wide

hours.v: aerodrome administration 24 hours, through the Airport Duty Manager

handling.v: ground handling and fuelling 24 hours; the AIP names SPdH and Portway as the handlers for cargo arrangements
handling.quote: Prior arrangements with SPdH and/or Portway

ppr.v: airport slots for non-based carriers allow at most 2 hours of parking; longer parking needs prior approval from Lisboa Airport Management
ppr.quote: Parking periods exceeding this interval, only upon prior approval from Lisboa Airport Management.

max_aircraft.v: some areas of the airfield are not available for Code F aircraft movements; the temporary parking area (stand 351) takes up to Code E aircraft
max_aircraft.quote: Some of the areas of the airfield are not currently available for Code F aircraft movements.
